_readme: The only file you edit by hand, and the night job also appends keywords it discovers. The job researches the market, picks the next video, writes the task and builds it. Change lang/topics/seed_keywords and the whole pipeline follows.
_lang_note: Set to en because the three topics target the high-CPM US/UK/AU market; change to vi for a Vietnamese audience and the pipeline follows, but ad revenue per view drops several times.
audience: Adults 20-45 who like short animated stories that explain why people do what they do
niche: Animated short films about decisions and what they cost: money, the mind, and invented mysteries
tone: Calm narrator, dry wit, no lecturing; stick-figure cast, lit 3D-toon backgrounds
value_promise: Every video is one story and one idea the viewer can use the same day

topics.name: Money stories
topics.angle: An invented person makes one money decision; the film follows what it costs and names the mechanism behind it
hard_rules: A story with a lesson, never advice: no 'buy this', no returns promised
No real companies, tickers, products or prices
The character is invented; no real person's situation is retold

topics.name: Behavioural psychology
topics.angle: Name one effect, show it happening to a character, then show the viewer where it happens in their own week
hard_rules: Describe a mechanism, never diagnose or prescribe
No claims about a named real person
Say when an effect is debated rather than stating it as settled

topics.name: Invented mysteries
topics.angle: A fictional case built from the SHAPE of real cases: the kind of deception, the kind of motive, the way it unravels. Everything else invented.
hard_rules: FICTION ONLY. Invented names, places, dates and outcome. Never a real case, named or recognizable.
Never claim truth anywhere: no 'true story', 'real case', 'based on real events', in title, description, caption or thumbnail
No graphic injury or death detail; the interest is the puzzle and the motive
No real victims, suspects, police forces or companies

Why: YouTube's harassment policy covers realistic recreations of real victims of violent events (strike, not just demonetization), and a recognizable real case with invented details is defamation. See data/platform-policy.md.

formats.name: story
formats.note: One situation with a hook, a turn and a payoff

formats.name: explainer
formats.note: One mechanism, 3-4 short scenes that show it, then where the viewer meets it

avoid: Real people, real brands, real cases, real logos or team kits
Advice on money, health or law; keep to stories and mechanisms
Graphic violence, shocking detail, anything aimed at children
Overblown promises in the title ('this will change your life')
Reusing a template with new nouns: every video is its own story (YouTube 'inauthentic content')

publish.ai_disclosure: Voice and visuals in this video are AI-generated. Characters and events are fictional.
